title: Align category and CMS canonical URLs with encoded sitemap paths
summary: Raw reserved characters in slugs could change canonical and structured-data URL semantics.

changes.detail: Use the existing seoPath encoder for category/CMS canonical and Open Graph URLs and category breadcrumb/CollectionPage identifiers.
Behavioral metadata and rendered JSON-LD regressions for ASCII, French, Arabic, query/hash/slash and literal percent slugs.
